review_method: Opened and visually inspected all three final Linux-rendered PNGs on Mac; no Mac modelling or rendering.
refinement: Version 1.1: re-rendered and visually reviewed after narrowing rear cap/seal/index ring to R10.84 mm and shrinking/reseating its three fasteners. Grip, front housing, pad, anchors and fine abrasive texture are unchanged.
limits: Standalone studio review plus a passing frame-350 native-hand triangle test at +20 mm tool0 seating. All-frame assembled-scene clearance is owned by the scene coordinator. Mass, seal design and pressure rating are not validated.
